verdict.rationale: Phoenix's docs show multi-step runs traced step by step: model calls, retrieval, tool use and custom logic are captured as spans. It offers OTLP ingestion, auto-instrumentation for agent frameworks, and decorators such as @tracer.chain and @tracer.tool for manual nesting. A Sessions feature groups related traces into conversations and user sessions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of parent/child span nesting and how session IDs are propagated, plus independent hands-on corroboration of session or thread grouping for agent runs.
